summary: Assemble validated immutable Git and semantic tree evidence into t2c.branch/v1

delivery.outcome: Produce one conservative t2c.branch/v1 portfolio from a validated immutable Git snapshot and exact tree-keyed graph/truth-map bundles
nonGoals: No exact-tree checkout, pipeline execution or artifact persistence
No Git or GitHub call and no PR metadata
No CLI, MCP, A2A, SDK or published schema
No repository, ref, index, worktree or branch mutation
No Goal, Koru or Validator consumer adapter

architecture.decision: Keep exact-tree analysis outside the assembler, validate real graph/truth bundles for every snapshot tree, and reuse the existing t2c.branch/v1 projector without another public DSL
dataChanges: Add an internal in-memory assembly envelope; the only canonical portfolio remains t2c.branch/v1
architecture.rollback: Remove the assembler and its focused test, and restore branch-snapshot.ts from accepted base; ticket-037 and ticket-039 behavior remain independently usable

validation.evidence: Malformed and fingerprint-tampered Git materializations fail closed
Exact unique-tree bundle coverage and shared-tree reuse tests pass
Added, removed and modified records retain valid assertion/record/relation citations
Semantic conflict and fail-closed unknown/manual-review cases pass
Textual and semantic outcomes remain independently asserted
Order/time invariance and changed-binding invalidation tests pass
Output stays t2c.branch/v1 and excludes authority, mutation and secret fields
Offline regression, governance, complexity and Docker gates pass
Follow-up workstreams remain excluded by allowedPaths and forbiddenPaths
